connector.name: Unraid MCP
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for Unraid API - provides tools to interact with an Unraid server's GraphQL API.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package unraid-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace tv.tootie. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: UNRAID_API_URL
env.description: Base URL of your Unraid server, e.g. http://192.168.1.100.
